book.name: PANKITE
book.title: Yeisu Keliso wana Pankite Diyon elana

content: Yaka anelose wewel sanisani, yawal ana wewel, i pankiteyau, matana i kanakana i ola gelasi, i sani noem Yehoba alona ge Sipi Natuna wali abamisiyo wawasana elana,

ge i sani noek panuwa ana kamwasa bwabwatana ana luwaluwala. Wewel bebena labui, yawal ana ebwakil i talmilila, iya waikena maisena ge maisena ni enoenon, inoke baliman maisena gamwanaa ni enon paelulutega eluwa. Ebwakil lamwana labi gegewena gamagaliliyau i pwamolol.
Ge bugul bolo Yehoba i towaagil nige nihi gagan. Yehoba alona ge Sipi Natuna wali abamisiyo wawasana ni minaa panuwa o gamwanaa, ge Yehoba wana totuwalali nihi tapwatapwalolo eliyana.
Maninina nihi kite ge alana ni gan lamwaliyaa.

Nige al bulin ni gagan, ge odam mwananalina ge sabwelu mwananalina nige al wali tuwalali ni gagan, kaiwena Yehoba Yabowaine iya wali mwananal. Ge heliya Yehoba wana totuwalali nihi tologugui sauga gegewena nige ni momowasi.
Liwan ana Ekaukaus

Yaka anelose i baem eliyau i ba, “Wasa bolo o hi tunahot ge bosowaina gamagalau nihi abulilek-an. Babala, iya Yabowaine toto komiu palopitau yayaluwamiu i papalut ge wana baaba ku baubaunan, nau wana anelose i patunau, inoke na pamasal wana totuwalali eliyamiu ge nuku atena hauna gun abwe sauga kekeisi ni gan.”
Babala i ba, “Ku kite! Sauga kekeisi na sikalim!” Bolo Yehoba wana baaba palopisai ana buki ya gamwanaa nihi henapuan, Yehoba ni muloluagil.
Nau Diyon bugul bolo o ya kitel ge baaba o ya hago. He sauga ya kite ge ya hago haba, yaka ya loepwakokuwa anelose toto bugul o i pankiteyau aenaa, ge tage na tapwalolo elana.
Yaa i baem elau i ba, “Bahiwa! Nau totuwalali ya, ya ola ya te owa alomwau ge talimwau wam pan palopitau, ge gamagalau gegewel bolo buki ya ana baaba hi henapuan. He nu tapwaloloek te Yehoba elana!”
Yaka i baem elau i ba, “Yehoba wana baaba palopisai ana buki ya gamwanaa bahi nu susume gamagalau elal, kaiwena sauga iyaka i mikelaubwa.

Ebo etega gegi i awaawaginol, he ni awaawaginol ya! Ebo etega pagan nanakina i awaawaginol, he ni awaawaginol ya! Yaa ebo etega pagan sasapona i awaawaginol inoke ni mimi awaawaginol, ge ebo etega i bwabwalena Yehoba elana inoke ni miola to.”
Babala i ba, “Ku kite! Sauga kekeisi na sikalim. Molamiu na pwatanim, inoke gamagal maisena ge maisena molana na pek, na golugoluwa wana ginol elana.
Nau Alepa ge Omega.
Nau ya houwa ge ya mulaa. Nau Abatelipuna ge Abapwamowasi.
“Bolo ali holahola hi ul i yanayana, Yehoba ni muloluagil. Heliya bosowailiya yawal ana ebwakil enona nihi an, ge bosowailiya nihi ulutuk nog elana nihi na panuwa gamwanaa.

Yaa bolo pagan pulupuluwawena hi giginol, tokukula, togaganawal, totaulol, bolo hi kululuek yabowaine kakakawel elal, ge bolo kakawi paganina hi nunuwana-an ge hi awaawaginol, heliya nihi miminaa panuwa tolinaa.

“Nau Yeisu no anelose ya patuna i nowa ge bugul bolo o i wasaan eliyamiu, komiu bolo ku miminaa ekelesiya elal. Nau Deibid wana boda tubutubunina, ge nau mweluluga putumwina kubwana, matana bwabwatana.”

Yayaluwa Bwabwalena alona ge Sipi Natuna ana kawakawalolu hi ba, “U nem!” Komiu gegewemiu bolo wasa ya ku hago nuku ba, “U nem!” Henala ebo ni walem ge nuwana wewel, he ni nem ge yawal ana wewel ni im bwabwage, nige molana i gagan.
Baaba Mowamowasena

Ya ba pagasisi gamagalau gegewemiu eliyamiu, bolo Yehoba wana baaba palopisai ana buki ya gamwanaa ku hago. Ebo gamagal etega nuwatu gegetogana eliyana buki ya ana baaba ni paetulan, he Yehoba gamagal o ana lahi ni paetulan al logabola bolo buki ya i baunagil eliyalil.

Ge ebo gamagal etega baaba enuna ni ahe yoho palopisai ana buki ya elana, he Yehoba waisi bolo buki ya i baunagil ni ahek yoho eliyana, nige ni tatalam yawal ana ebwakil enona ni an ge ni ulutuk panuwa bwabwalena eliyana.
Yeisu, iya bugul bolo o wasaliya i wasaan, i ba i ola hiwe: “Tunahot, sauga kekeisi na sikalim.” Ibwe. I ola! Babala Yeisu, u nem!
Babala Yeisu wana mulolu ni minaa ku gewigewi eliyamiu.

footnotes.text: Kubwana, matana bwabwatana, ana nuwatu i noek te Yeisu iya sauga kekeisi abwe lan toto waiwaisana ge mihomihotina ni pwatanim.
